findings.title: The pushed-branch check has no specified source for the local SHA
findings.description: `check_head_pushed` requires `local_sha`, but no task specifies obtaining it (for example, with `git rev-parse HEAD`) or passing it from the command. Task 3 adds the current branch helper and commit-range helper, neither of which supplies the local head SHA. The host/local comparison therefore lacks a specified input and is not independently implementable as written.

findings.title: The real-task-file parser test will become state-dependent
findings.description: The real-file test requires both parsed groups to be non-empty. When this task file is complete, its checkboxes are expected to be checked, so the unchecked group can become empty and the test can fail despite correct parser behavior. Use a stable fixture captured from a real task file, or avoid requiring both groups to remain non-empty as task state changes.

findings.title: Provider-failure coverage does not verify the CLI avoids the PR write
findings.description: Task 10.2 tests the composer’s failure in isolation, where it cannot make a PR write. Task 13.2 covers command-level refusals but does not include a failing composer. The slice’s success criterion that a provider failure exits non-zero and creates nothing therefore lacks a command-level test asserting that `open_pull_request` is not called.
